name: rule
wording: a working convention an agent follows in whatever project it works in, stated once as the convention and why it holds; in force in every project once installed; never a prohibition against a failure not seen in real use; a project's own conventions stay in its own files, never a rule
reason: Moved from canon: canon's subject was an inventory of what cratylus ships, which is the product itself, not a concept; a rule and a ruleset are things an agent works by, in the same language as skill, so they belong to agents.
